# Task M-05a: the data a song page needs (backend)

**Phase:** maintenance · **Depends on:** none · **Suggested tier:** Sonnet subagent · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal

Owner request (2026-10-10): every song gets its own page, like an episode or movie page in Sonarr/Radarr, opened by clicking the song's title, "with value-adds about the song from any sources available". M-05b builds the page; this task gives it the data, in the existing *arr-style API (`/api/v1`, `X-Api-Key`).

## Deliverables

1. **The file, in full.** `SongFileResource` (`src/Wondarr.Api/Songs/SongResource.cs` ~63) gains, additively, what `SongFile` already stores: `sampleRate`, `bitDepth`, `channels`, `durationMs`, `qualityId` (on disk) next to the song's downloaded quality, `acoustId`, `fingerprintVerified`, `importedAt`, `tagsWritten`, `replayGainDb`, `replayGainPeak`, and a parsed `source` object from `source_ref` with only safe fields (e.g. for a reference file the reference library's id and name and the relative path; for a download the queue/source title if stored) — never a secret or a full JSON blob.
2. **`GET /api/v1/song/{id}/details`** → `SongDetailsResource`, everything the page shows that `GET /song/{id}` does not:
   - `releases`: the song's cached release options (the same source as `/albumcontexts`: title, album artist, type, date, cover URL as M-04 builds it — share one mapper with M-04 if it has landed, else build the same rule here and leave a note).
   - `musicBrainz`: recording id, first release date, disambiguation, ISRCs, artist credit, a link (`https://musicbrainz.org/recording/{id}`) — from the stored identity where possible; one MusicBrainz recording lookup only when the stored data lacks it, through the existing rate-limited client (1 req/s).
   - `deezer` (when the song has a Deezer id): link, rank (popularity), explicit flag, **BPM** and **gain** (parse `bpm`/`gain` from the existing `track/{id}` call — extend `DeezerTrack`), release date, album cover URL. One call per request through the existing client, cached in memory for 1 hour per Deezer id.
   - `referenceFile` (when the song is owned through a reference library): library id and name, relative path, identified by, confidence, state.
   - `lyrics`: availability only (`sidecar` synced/plain present next to the file, or `none`), not the text.
   Every external part is optional: a failing or slow source (timeout 5 s) leaves its section `null` and the endpoint still answers 200.
3. **`GET /api/v1/song/{id}/lyrics`** → `{ source: "sidecar" | "lrclib" | null, synced: string?, plain: string? }`: the `.lrc`/`.txt` sidecar next to the song's file if present; otherwise one LRCLIB lookup through the existing `LrclibClient` (title, artist, duration), cached in memory for 1 day. Never writes a sidecar (that stays the import's job). `lyrics.enabled: false` → `{ source: null }` without a lookup.
4. **Per-song filters:** `GET /api/v1/queue?songId=` and `GET /api/v1/blocklist?songId=` (additive query parameters; existing callers unchanged). History already has `songId`.
5. Regenerate `docs/api/openapi.json` (snapshot test with `WONDARR_UPDATE_OPENAPI=1`) and `frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts` (`cd frontend && npm run gen:api`). Add typed hooks in `frontend/src/api/songs.ts` (`useSong(id)`, `useSongDetails(id)`, `useSongLyrics(id, enabled)`), `queue.ts` (`songId` on the queue hook) and `wanted.ts` (`songId` on `useBlocklist`) — hooks only, no UI.

## Allowed paths

- `src/Wondarr.Api/Songs/**`, `src/Wondarr.Api/Queue/**`, `src/Wondarr.Api/Blocklist/**`
- `src/Wondarr.Core/Songs/**`, `src/Wondarr.Core/Metadata/Deezer/**`, `src/Wondarr.Core/Lyrics/**`, `src/Wondarr.Core/Queue/**`, `src/Wondarr.Core/Blocklist/**` (and the service the blocklist/queue endpoints use, wherever it lives)
- `tests/Wondarr.Api.Tests/**`, `tests/Wondarr.Core.Tests/**`
- `docs/api/openapi.json`, `frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts`, `frontend/src/api/songs.ts`, `frontend/src/api/queue.ts`, `frontend/src/api/wanted.ts` (and their tests if present)

## Constraints

- AGENTS.md external limits (MusicBrainz 1 req/s with the User-Agent, honour `Retry-After`): go through the existing clients only.
- No migration. No secret in any resource.
- A song in a reference library: its file is never written by any of this (read only).

## Acceptance criteria

1. `dotnet build -warnaserror`; `dotnet test` Core then Api (one at a time); `cd frontend && npm run typecheck && npm test` green.
2. Tests: the extended file resource (a download and a reference file); `/details` with all sources stubbed, with Deezer failing (section null, 200), and the 1-hour cache (one Deezer call for two requests); `/lyrics` from a sidecar, from LRCLIB (one call for two requests), and disabled; the `songId` filters on queue and blocklist; 404 for an unknown song on each new endpoint.

## Out of scope

- The page itself (M-05b). Last.fm (no global key exists; not added here).

## Done-report

Use the format in `docs/build/WORKER_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md`.
